accessibility_support_other: All videos have captions and a full transcript; the synthetic voice-over describes everything shown on screen.
comments: ADDAW is a Spanish non-profit association working on digital accessibility audits and training. Levels 1 to 3 (courses, exams and certificates) are completely free; in levels 4 to 7 the courses are free and the level exam and certificate are paid.
description: Vendor-neutral program in Spanish: 40 self-paced online courses (about 86 hours) in 7 levels, from fundamentals to WCAG 2.2 auditing, EN 301 549, the European Accessibility Act, documents, mobile apps and multimedia. Captioned video lessons, quizzes and hands-on exercises on real pages. Free courses; each level ends with an exam and certificate.
length: About 86 hours (40 courses of about 2 hours each)
prerequisites: None for level 1; each level builds on the previous ones
provider: ADDAW (Asociación para la Defensa del Derecho a la Accesibilidad Web)
title: Cursos de accesibilidad digital de ADDAW: programa de certificación en 7 niveles (ADDAW digital accessibility courses: 7-level certification program)
topics: Accessibility foundations, disability and assistive technologies
Accessibility policy and regulations (EN 301 549, European Accessibility Act, Spanish law)
Accessible design, content, documents, mobile apps and multimedia
